title: asperula capillacea
intro: Asperula capillacea, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The health benefits of Asperula capillacea include its potential use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and act as an antiseptic, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Asperula capillacea include iridoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
